definitions.gloss: Girls' Day festival; Peach Festival; Doll Festival
definitions.explanation: A traditional festival on March 3rd celebrating the health and happiness of girls. Families display ornamental dolls on tiered platforms and eat special foods like chirashi sushi and hina arare.

examples.japanese: {桃|もも}の{節句|せっく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雛人形|ひなにんぎょう}→雛人形：14830_hinaningyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: We display hina dolls for Girls' Day.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Also called ⟦ひな{祭|まつ}り→ひな祭り：10517_hinamatsuri⟧ (Doll Festival). One of the {五節句|ごせっく} (five seasonal festivals). The name comes from the peach blossoms (⟦{桃|もも}→桃：04382_momo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧) that bloom around this time. Families with daughters display elaborate tiered platforms ({雛壇|ひなだん}) with ornamental dolls representing the imperial court. Traditional foods include {菱餅|ひしもち} (diamond-shaped rice cakes), {雛|ひな}あられ (bite-sized rice crackers), and ⟦{甘酒|あまざけ}→甘酒：13519_amazake⟧ or {白酒|しろざけ}.
